name: nox
description: NOX - orchestration du developpement assiste par IA

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @nox/web
scripts.dev:runner: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @nox/runner
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @nox/runner && npm run build --workspace @nox/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
